records.subject: Community and Social Services
records.title: Households Assisted Through Comcare Schemes, Annual
records.dataSource: MINISTRY OF SOCIAL AND FAMILY DEVELOPMENT
records.footnote: Data refer to households that have received assistance under the respective ComCare Schemes within the respective calendar year.   Household comprises all immediate family members (i.e., parents, spouse, siblings, and children (biological, adopted as indicated in adoption certificate, or step)) residing at the same address.  Not all household members are necessarily beneficiaries.  For instance, a household may contain estranged but financially self-reliant members, who are not contributing financially to the needs of the family.  These members may not be considered beneficairies when ComCare assistance is disbursed.

row.footnote: Overall data are based on unique headcounts of households that received Short-to-Medium Term Assistance, Long Term Assistance, or Student Care Fee Assistance.  That is, a household who received assistance from one or more ComCare Schemes is only counted once.

row.rowText: Comcare Short-To-Medium Term Assistance For Households
row.footnote: Comprises schemes that were previously known as Work Support Programme and ComCare Transitions.

row.rowText: Comcare Long Term Assistance For Households
row.footnote: ComCare Long Term Assistance is also known as Public Assistance.

row.rowText: Student Care Fee Assistance For Households
row.footnote: Data is based on unique headcounts.  That is, a child who was in more than one household is only counted once.
